units.source_text: 今天就是為了孩子們才來這裡買些東西呢。」等等，

en.t: Today I came here just to buy some things for the children," and so on,

units.source_text: 我們像久別重逢的朋友，彼此寒暄著一些客套話，接著互相打聽共同認識的朋友的近況。

en.t: We spoke like friends reunited after a long separation, exchanging polite small talk and then asking each other about the recent circumstances of friends we both knew.

units.source_text: 不一會兒，老闆娘語氣一轉，問我：「你認識小葉嗎？」

en.t: After a little while, the madam changed her tone and asked me, "Do you know Yozo?"
I said, "I do not know him."

units.source_text: 老闆娘走進櫃檯內，拿來三本筆記本和三張照片，交給我說道：「說不定能當作小說題材呢。」

en.t: The madam went behind the counter, brought back three notebooks and three photographs, handed them to me, and said, "They might perhaps serve as material for a novel."
